name: Xoi
summary: Xôi is dense sticky rice, savoury or sweet. Vietnam Tourism calls savoury xôi mặn an inexpensive breakfast and says there are more than 20 sweet kinds. The Hanoi door on that list is Xôi Yến. Xôi is also on the Huỳnh Thúc Kháng breakfast list in Da Nang. The 18 May 2020 page and the 19 Jun 2019 roundup both name it. Neither says which sticky rice, or what is on top.
origin: The dish list places the Hanoi bowl at Xôi Yến in Hoàn Kiếm. Five-colour sticky rice on the same list is a type, not this city’s only xôi. In Da Nang it is named as a breakfast on those two city pages. A topping list was not printed.
howToEat: Xôi mặn is the savoury breakfast. Xôi ngọt is the sweet side, and the list says there are more than 20 sweet kinds.
The same list describes xôi ngũ sắc as purple, green, red, yellow, and white, coloured with plant extracts. It does not say that bowl is the one at Xôi Yến.
The Da Nang breakfast pages name xôi and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Xôi Yến, 35B Nguyễn Hữu Huân, Lý Thái Tổ, Hoàn Kiếm. The hour is Check on arrival.
In Da Nang, Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The 2020 page says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 page prints 06:00–12:00.
seoDescription: Xôi in Hanoi is dense sticky rice, savoury at breakfast or sweet. Vietnam Tourism names Xôi Yến at 35B Nguyễn Hữu Huân. Huỳnh Thúc Kháng in Da Nang names xôi and does not say which rice or what is on top.
